response.sql: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM "order" AS o JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), scored AS (SELECT account_id, region, order_count, order_count - (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM order_counts) AS difference FROM order_counts), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY difference DESC) AS place FROM scored) SELECT account_id, region, order_count, difference FROM ranked WHERE place <= 10 ORDER BY difference DESC, account_id;
